steps.en: Install the library into your Python environment
steps.zh: 把库装进 Python 环境

steps.en: Point the converter at a file or URL
steps.zh: 把转换器指向一个文件或 URL

steps.en: Runs layout, reading-order, table-structure and OCR models, merges everything into one DoclingDocument
steps.zh: 跑版面、表格结构与 OCR 模型，合成一个 DoclingDocument

steps.en: Serialize the result for your chunker
steps.zh: 把结果序列化成给分块器的输出

value.en: Markdown/JSON with columns, tables and headings intact — RAG-ready input without hand-written parsing
value.zh: 栏目、表格、标题都完好的 Markdown/JSON——不用手写解析就得到可直接喂 RAG 的输入

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09-28 Quickstart: 'pip install docling'; 'from docling.document_converter import DocumentConverter'; 'converter = DocumentConverter()'; 'result = converter.convert(source)'; 'print(result.document.export_to_markdown())'; CLI 'docling https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.01062' generates a .md file
docs docling-project.github.io/docling/usage/ (2026-09-28): same Python snippet; OCR concepts page + docling/datamodel/pipeline_options.py: OcrAutoOptions default, layout model Heron
